phase: After 86 declared engineering boundary/point evaluations; before independent validation, source-data rendering or inverse training
scope: Face-on Schwarzschild, static observer r=100M, circular emitting material on equatorial surface annulus [6,12]M, crossing angles pi/2+n*pi for n=0,1,2. Specific surface intensity times g^3, no absorption. Exact finite-observer rescaled solid-angle measure. Not Kerr, volumetric NeRF, VLBI, PSF, interval proof or real observing forecast.

physics_and_budget.count: Every b/order native, reference and boundary residual evaluation including failures; 86 pre-registration engineering calls included
physics_and_budget.independent_formulations: Turning-point regularized radial quadrature versus observer-initialized u(psi),uprime,coordinate-time ODE

detector.noise: One fixed absolute white-noise density calibrated on unit-source direct reference, shared across all orders/pixels; integrated variance equals sigma^2 times exact rescaled solid-angle area
detector.scope: Geometry-located emitting image annuli, distinct order windows, ideal resolution

source_and_inverse.source_twins: Matched, first event, both events; same direct data expected by support separation, to be checked
source_and_inverse.PINN: Huber residual (d_t+Omega*d_phi)j/0.03, fixed multiplier 0.03, 256 collocation points
source_and_inverse.primary_source_metric: Radially weighted relative L2 of contrast j-1 over declared old-source grid
source_and_inverse.event_increment_metric: Difference of paired reconstructed event and matched-source fields versus true transient, with shared noise
source_and_inverse.classical_selection: Training-only generalized cross-validation over fixed ridge grid
source_and_inverse.staging_interpretation: Package of additive representation and training order, not isolated causal effect of boosting

Euler_paper.borrowed_for_test: Structured coordinates, staged residual correction, separation of candidate from independent validation

delivery: Full sources and final results will be additive; exact committed file digests checked before their launch. This is development registration, not an externally sealed main. Every failed attempt, any implementation correction and all candidate outcomes are retained.
